headline: Nutritious Campus Meals at Student-Friendly Prices
subheadline: NutriNest connects hostel students with healthy local mess providers, offering flexible meal plans and fast campus delivery.

geoff_moore_template.statement_of_need: who struggle to find affordable healthy daily meals
geoff_moore_template.product_category: student food discovery & meal subscription platform
geoff_moore_template.key_benefit: delivers fresh, home-style healthy meals under $3 per serving
geoff_moore_template.primary_competitor: generic food delivery apps like Swiggy and Zomato
geoff_moore_template.our_differentiation: focuses exclusively on curated student nutrition, campus mess subscriptions, and group hostel discounts.

elevator_pitch_30s: NutriNest is solving the daily food crisis for college students. Over 70% of hostel residents skip healthy meals due to high prices on traditional delivery apps. NutriNest aggregates local healthy mess vendors into a single subscription app, giving students fresh, home-cooked food delivered straight to campus dorms for under $3 a meal.
unique_selling_points: Curated daily nutrition plans designed for student budgets
Flexible skip-or-swap meal subscriptions during exams

pain_relief_matrix.customer_pain: Expensive food delivery fees on generic apps
pain_relief_matrix.relief_value: Cuts delivery charges to zero by bundling dorm orders together

pain_relief_matrix.customer_pain: Unhealthy junk food options near university areas
pain_relief_matrix.relief_value: Ensures clean, balanced meals certified by campus dietitians
